text:
-ANONYMOUS for someone else- 

I have been on the partner visa for several years now (was supposed to receive A5 at the next renewal) however my partner and I recently split up. I’ve been accepted to a one-year fellowship program through an Israeli institution and need to apply for an A2 student visa. Can I switch my visa status from within Israel? And besides the bureaucratic aspect, has anyone done this and had problems with the MH (i.e. them not granting the visa due to my previous status)?
